name: The Forest Zone
info:
It was supposed to just be a fun adventure in a new VR MMO, 
you were excited to join the beta test just like everyone else. 
Then this madman in a hood shows up and traps everyone here 
to be victims in their game. You weren't alone though. You met a guy 
named Mark, and after saving each other you decided to 
travel together, joined by your AI companion 'PXE'.

name: The Coastal Zone
info:
You, Mark and PXE pooled together the information you knew and 
looked around for clues. Through trials and tribulations 
you collected the items needed for a ritual which brought you to 
the Sea Goddess' bishop. After a battle with her, you obtained a 
treasure of the zone, and came to the conclusion each zone 
must have a similar treasure. You and Mark went seperate ways 
to search for these treasures and you ran into a woman named 
Alaru. After helping her save a town from monsters, 
she joined your party and offered to guide you to the next zone.

name: The Demon Zone
info:
With Alaru in tow you reached the Demon Zone, but a mysterious 
magic seperated your group and left you alone in a city 
controlled by demons. A friendly doppelganger there even helped you 
unlock a new power, to steal the abilities of your foes. Using this 
new power you fought back against the demons and their 
leader, Alaru's sister Amarya. With Amarya defeated Alaru 
asked for your assistance, taking down her vampire mother. 
After avoiding a strange, gun-toting biker, the two of you 
reached the vampire's castle and took her down.

name: The Desolate Zone
info:
Alaru stayed behind to watch over her family and you entered 
the Desolate Zone with only PXE at your side. She was quickly 
stripped away by Robin, as she had grown beyond her AI constraints. 
With only a glitching AI at your side you continued on. You were 
even bit by a zombie, and travelled alongside another 
player named Kim to search for a cure. The biker showed up 
again, causing chaos as she went. Eventually you reached a 
mansion, with a hacker-turned scientist within. She had to be 
put down after going to far with her experiments however.

name: The Desert Zone
info:
You reached the burning sands of the Desert alongside Kim and 
encountered other adventurers, Dominic and Fera, also intent on 
finding the zone treasure. Goals aligned, you teamed up and together 
uncovered a great pyramid. Dominic stormed forward without 
you and got himself possessed by an ancient spirit who 
captured the rest of you. With the help of a ghostly goddess 
you managed to break free, rescue your allies, and defeat 
the new pharaoh. She cursed you as she died, but all was well 
in the end and a repentant Domninic even joined the party.

name: Back to the City
info:
Looking for a way to remove the pharaoh's curse so you could 
leave the desert the goddess Isis pointed you towards her daughter 
Bastet. She would remove the curse for a price, and you headed 
back to the Desolate Zone to retieve a magic collar. The city 
was beset by wolves under the control of the biker Lina. 
You and Kim took down a hacker creating more collars and 
proceeded to chase down Lina herself. Your bikes crashed and 
she had you at gunpoint, but Kim somehow managed to reflect 
the shot and defeat the biker.

name: The Mythic Zone
info:
Your party recieved an invitation to a royal ball when you 
entered the Mythic Zone which you accepted. The invitation was from 
the King himself, begging you to find his missing daughter. 
At the same time you realised Fera had been kidnapped. Intent 
on saving both you ventured out, falling prey to a trap 
that left you stuck in the princess' body for a while and 
getting tricked by Robin into believing Fera was actually in 
danger from shrine maidens. The princess was saved, and 
Fera embraced a new purpose as a guardian.

name: The Mythic Zone
info:
There was one more thing to do in the Mythic Zone. Help PXE. 
Still glitching from Robin's attack the only way to help her was 
finding the other fae. This quest lead you in to the woods and to 
a strange realm called The Gleaming. There you collected 
'letters of introduction' from the rulers there to meet Queen Titania. 
Titania was actually a computer program in charge of creating 
PXEs for Robin and captured you all. Your own mind glitching, you 
managed to rescue the others and even restore PXE to normal, 
fighting back against Titania and escaping the realm.

name: The Breachwoods
info:
The Breachwoods encompase the entirety of the Forest Zone, 
featuring many interesting locations like cave systems and rivers. 
Humans also make their home in the forest as seen by the northern 
Breachwood Village and Caste City to the south. Some ranchers 
have also been known to turn clearings into areas for livestock.

name: Caste City
info: Stuck between the Breachwood Forest and the ocean beyond, this \nhuman city boasts walls of high stone, strong enough to withstand \nany monster's attack. But all walls crumble eventually.

name: Eurum City
info:
Rather small for a city, this quaint tropical paradise lies on the 
edge of the Eurus Sea. The north road takes you up to the Budan 
River, while the east heads toward the forest zone. Like most places 
by the sea, the local trade is fishing.

name: Eurus Sea
info:
This vast sea is enclosed by sharp, deadly rocks. It is said this is 
the reason for it's high concentration of deadly monsters, many 
creatures make their homes here from the peaceful Sea Slimes to 
the deadly Mershark. Supposedly the entire sea is protected 
by a goddess.

name: Budan River
info:
A wide, gentle river that splits the Coastal Zone in half, the 
Budan is home to many different races. From the humans living the 
island village to the sahaguin's hiding out in the caves and the 
upper banks. Unlike the nearby city of Eurum, or the island of 
Dirian, the humans living on the Budan don't believe in the Sea 
Goddess, perhaps because of their frequent clashes with their 
monstrous neighbours.

name: Elysium City
info:
Nestled within a decaying forest and surrounded by thick 
impenetrable walls lies the city of Elysium, named for the ancient 
tale of a blessed plain, this was once a place of beauty and 
happiness but with corruption seeping into the roots the town is 
now nothing but a shell of it's former self. Dark work goes on 
behind closed doors and evil sets in motion plans for the innocent 
civilians that call it home. In the center of the sickly river lies 
the shining beacon of Elysium, it's great cathedral.

name: Hilltop Castle
info:
From the dark sewers to the tallest tower, this castle is one 
imposing structure. Owned long ago by a human noble, the castle is 
now the home of the Vampire Queen Draculara and her kin. The 
castle itself looms over the city of Elysium, as per the request of 
it's original owner for some long forgotten reason. The sewers far 
below are quite the twisting maze of tunnels, supposedly reaching 
as far as the Desolate Zone and are inhabited by ratfolk and 
gator alike.

name: Barricade Turf
info:
On the western edge of the city that makes up the Desolate Zone, 
lies a town created around the St.Robin's Memorial Hospital. Here, 
the inhabitants fight bravely to defend their new home and their 
friends. Zombies swarm outside the hastily built walls and armed 
guards fight on, desperate for the hordes to stop. The only saving 
grace being that other monsters seem to fear the zombies as much 
as humans and haven't shown themselves since the horde arrived.

name: Mansion Approach
info:
East of the river that divides the zone, a mall holds this area's 
suriving humans, whether they be players or NPCs. The outside 
streets from the mall's exterior to the outskirts of the city park 
are swarming with zombies, wandering like lost children. And at the 
edge of the long road sits a old fashioned mansion, out of place 
among the city sights. A place known as one where many 
adventurers enter, looking for loot and rewards, but none ever leave.

name: Northern Streets
info:
Sitting in the shadow of the looming mountains, the northern roads 
of the city are long and fraught with danger. With the zombies 
finally expelled the true owners of the city have returned, monsters 
of all kind have flocked to the area in hopes of catching some lone 
human as prey. On the eastern side of the river lies a safe place, 
originally a part of Barricade Town, but now cut off from it's sister 
town. The town still goes unnamed however, as its people have more 
important things to worry about.

name: Western Dunes
info:
Atop a dusty hill lies a small camp, safe from the sandwurms that 
roam the sands. The nearby river provides fresh water from the 
mountains and keeps the shores green and bountiful. Even so, not all 
is safe here. An evil lurks just beneath the surface, festering and 
growing stronger as it waits to emerge. Ruins and lonely pillars 
dot the dunes, memories of days long past, or perhaps a prophecy 
for the future.

name: Eastern Dunes
info:
A dried up dead riverbed, a dusty mirror of the western desert. 
Overlooking it lies the town of Djeso, protected from the harsh 
sandstorms and wurms by it's high walls. The citizens, clustered 
around their little oasis, can still see the volcano over the walls, 
or at least its plume of black smoke. Few dare to venture close, 
for fear of the lava, and the volcano's fiesty, scaled inhabitants. 
It said Djeso was originally built by miners from a place beyond the 
mountains that enshroud the desert.

name: Mirane Captial
info:
The captial city of the Kingdom of Mirane, a walled bastion against 
the monsters and inhumans of the woods. Densely packed together 
houses and shops make up the poorer parts of downtown. 
Comfy homes, opens markets and fancy shops decorate the midtown. 
No matter where you are however, you're always in the shadow 
of the castle.

name: Mystic Woods
info:
Thick and misty, it's not hard to lose ones way within the trees 
of the Mystic Woods. Entry is barred to most due to the danger 
within and those that do enter often find themselves with the 
feeling of being watched. A few brave or perhaps foolish 
souls make their home within, most notably the shrine maidens, 
who have carved out a place of safety and sanctuary not just 
from the woods inhabitants.

name: The Gleaming
info:
An shadow of reality where the fae make their home. Ordered and 
chaotic at the same time, The Gleaming is a place not suited to 
humans or the inhabitants of 'Humdrum' as the fae call them. 
Those living here have seperated themselves into three courts, 
ruled by the most powerful fae around, who hoard their stolen 
riches of memories and lives. Even the fae fear what lies 
above however, the home of their true ruler. The Emerald 
Shadow is home to 'Queen Titania', supposedly a fae so powerful 
and unsettling that even the court leaders fear her.

name: PXE
info:
This adorable little fairy is your 'Personal Xanadu Expert' an 
incredibly helpful little AI. While all players of Monline start 
with their own PXE most disable theirs quickly. Supposedly some 
players find the PXE's 'annoying'.

name: PXE
info: Your 'Personal Xanadu Expert', after an encounter with Robin she was \n'reset' in an attempt to quell her fury towards the game's \ncreator. Now she is in a constant state of glitching.

name: PXE
info:
Fixed of her glitches, and her memory restorted, PXE is working at 
full functionality. After the events at the Emerald Shadow PXE 
Processing Facility left her the sole survivor of her 'species', 
she has vowed to help humanity fight back against Robin.

name: Robin
info:
The ruler of the world of Monline and the one who trapped everyone 
here. Supposedly the sole designer of Monline, although you never 
took much notice of the developer's names during the game's 
production. Robin appears to have a love of transformation and 
has roped the entire playerbase into being the victims of their 
twisted game.

name: Mark
info: Just another player who started out in the Forest Zone like you. \nSo far you've both saved each other from near certain doom.

name: Mark
info:
Just another player who started out in the Forest Zone like you. 
So far you've both saved each other from near certain doom. 
After defeating the Sea Bishop and obtaining the first Orb, the 
two of you decided to part ways in search of the others. Him heading 
west, you heading east. Hopefully it won't take long for you 
both to reunite.

name: Percy
info: Despite the strange goings on around him this one seems to care \nvery little for his own safety and instead spends his time \ndocumenting each of the monsters he encounters.

name: Aralu
info: Aralu is a rather strange woman obsessed with doling out justice \nto the monsters that roam the island.

name: Aralu
info:
Child of the Vampire Queen Draculara, Aralu is a Dhampir, a 
half-vampire half-human hybrid. Fearful of becoming like her mother 
she ran away and began enacting justice on those who couldn't 
control their inhuman impulses, the monsters of Xanadu. With your 
help she defeated her sister, the High Succubus Amarya, and slayed 
her mother. Now she resides in the castle above Elysium City, 
teaching her younger siblings in hopes they may turn out like her.

name: Kim
info: After meeting Kim at the edge of the Desolate Zone she's joined up \nwith you as an attempt to find the source of the zombie outbreak \nand avenge her friend.

name: Kim
info:
After meeting Kim at the edge of the Desolate Zone she joined up 
with you as an attempt to find the source of the zombie outbreak 
and avenge her friend. With the mad scientist Mara defeated, the 
two of you continued on together, determined to defeat Robin and 
save the people trapped in this world. She's kind-hearted and 
intelligent, though she has a fierce temper and is just a slight 
bit too naive at times.

name: Lina
info:
A vile woman who relishes the power the world of Monline has given her 
over others. Formerly working under the scientist Mara, 
she fled when the woman turned lich was defeated and her 
whereabouts are now unknown.

name: Lina
info:
Her evil actions have finally caught up with her, having fallen prey 
to a reflected shot from her own Bimboizing Ray Gun 
this happy-go-lucky biker remembers nothing of her former self. 
It's probably better that way for everyone.

name: Morgan
info: Having lost his own party and friends early on during his adventure, \nthis man has turned to any means necessary to survive, \neven allying with the scientist Mara and her immoral experiments.

name: Morgan
info:
Having lost his own party and friends early on during his adventure, 
this man has turned to any means necessary to survive. 
During your time in the Pyramid he willingly worked with the Pharaoh 
Farinet so as not to suffer the fate of her 'subjects'.

name: Dominic
info:
In the real world he was a popular streamer called 'DMO', and was 
known for his actions in many other games. In Monline he is just as 
popular with his fans and is using them to hunt down the Desert 
Zone's treasure. 
He seems to be friends with the wildwoman Fera.

name: Dominic
info:
After a not so impressive introduction where he fought against you 
at Morgan's side and was possessed by a Pharaoh, Dominic joined 
your team to make amends for his failure, at the request of his 
friend Fera. More than a little vain and popularity obsessed, 
Dominic also goes by the online handle 'DMO' to his streams viewers.

name: Fera
info:
A rather strange woman, Fera is mostly quiet and prefers to talk 
in short stilted sentences or animal like growls. She allied 
herself with the group in order to stop her friend Dominic from 
making a foolish mistake. Despite her somewhat standoffish 
personality she has an odd sense of humour that she is not afraid to 
show off.

name: Fera
info:
Claiming herself to be an 'actor' of sorts, this roleplayer has 
gracefully accepted her new role as shrine maiden and host to 
the Kitsune spirit. Kitsune worked to protect those from Robin's 
corruption and all was going well until you stumbled in and 
ruined everything. Despite everything her personality hasn't changed and 
she still seems to enjoy teasing others, especially with a prankster 
spirit within her.

name: Delta
info:
A self proclaimed genius hacker who worked with Lina to design 
mind controlling collars for her. He used the collars to create 
his own harem of slaves before being stopped by you and Kim. 
After running back to Lina with his tail between his legs she 
betrayed and collared him turning him into the loyal dog-like gremlin 
she is now. After Lina was defeated Delta fled and her whereabouts 
are now unknown.

name: Princess Rien
info:
Heir to the throne of Mirane, she was formerly missing after 
running away to hunt down her friend's kidnapper and getting herself 
petrified. During the hunt for her your ran into a magical trap she 
set and ended up as her 'replacement'. 
She is prim and proper but with a fiesty personality, and 
the magical prowess to back that up.

name: Death
info: The afflicted won't be able to fight, use items or guard! \nThis state is automatically applied when you run out of HP.

name: Poison
info: At the end of the turn the affected person will take damage based \non their MAT stat, this effect cannot cause death. \nLasts 1-5 turns.

name: Blind
info: Lowers the afflicted's chance to hit by 40%. \nLasts 1 turn.

name: Sealed
info: The afflicted cannot use any Abilities while Sealed! \nLasts 2-3 turns.

name: Enraged
info: The afflicted attacks at random and can even hit their allies! \nLasts 2-4 turns. 50% chance to be removed when taking damage.

name: Sleep
info: The afflicted cannot act or evade attacks. \nLasts 2-3 turns. Removed when taking damage.

name: Paralysis
info: The afflicted cannot evade attacks. \nLasts 1-3 turns. 50% chance to be removed when taking damage.

name: Stun
info: The afflicted cannot act or evade attacks. \nLasts 1 turn. 50% chance to be removed when taking damage.

name: Provoke
info: The afflicted is far more likely to be targeted. \nLasts 3 turns.

name: HP Regen
info: Increases the afflicted's HP Regeneration Rate by 6%. \nLasts 4 turns. 40% chance to be removed when taking damage.

name: MP Regen
info: Increases the afflicted's MP Regeneration Rate by 6%. \nLasts 4 turns.

name: AD Regen
info: Increases the afflicted's AD Regeneration Rate by 8%. \nLasts 4 turns.

name: Ironbody
info: The afflicted takes 30% less damage from Physical Attacks. \nLasts 3 turns.

name: Frisky
info:
The afflicted takes double damage from Lust based attacks and is 
25% more likely to become Charmed. The afflicted gains AD as 125% 
the normal rate and their weapon attacks do Lust damage. 
Lasts 2-3 turns. 20% chance to be removed when taking damage.

name: Calm
info:
The afflicted gains 3% HP and MP Regeneration, takes 10% less 
damage and has a 25% chance to be able to act twice. The afflicted 
also cannot be inflicted with Frisky or Enraged. 
Lasts 4 turns. 20% chance to be removed when taking damage. 
If the state is removed due to lasting the full 4 turns, the 
afflicted becomes Exhausted.

name: Risen
info: The afflicted's ATK and MAT stats are increased by 25%. \nTypically applied after being revived. \nLasts 2 turns.

name: Flurry
info: The afflicted gains an extra action each turn, and a 50% chance to \ngain an additional extra action each turn. \nLasts 2 turns.

name: Burned
info:
The afflicted's healing rate from abilties and items is reduced 
by 25%. At the end of the turn the affected person will take damage 
based on their ATK stat, this effect cannot cause death.  
Lasts 3-4 turns.

name: Chilled
info: The afflicted's attack speed is reduced by 10 stages. \nTheir Evasion rate is also reduced by 50%. \nLasts 3-4 turns.

name: Stinky
info: The afflicted's healing rate from abilities and items is reduced by 50%. \nLasts 3-5 turns.

name: Dizzy
info:
"The afflicted's Evasion and Hit rates are reduce 
by 50%. Every time they attack they'll take damage 
based on their ATK or MAT stat. Lasts 1-3 turns. 
50% chance to be removed when taking damage.",                                  :image? => false

name: Exhaustion
info: The afflicted can't move and takes double damage. \nLasts 2 turns.

name: Anchored
info: The afflicted is immune to Stun, Dizzy, Paralysis and Sleep. \nLasts 3 turns.

name: Basic Controls
info:
Arrow Keys: Move on the map, move the menu cursor. 
Z: Interact, Select Menu Option. 
X: Cancel. 
A: Hides the Text Box. 
Shift: Toggles Sprint on the map. 
Ctrl: Speeds up text. 
F6: Change Screen Size. 
F12: Return to the Title Screen (Unstable!)

name: QTE Controls
info:
At times, while exploring the world you maybe be 
required to act quickly and input a series of specific 
key presses to proceed. If you fail to press the 
correct keys in order before time runs out there may 
be dire consequences. The keys you may be asked to 
press are: Z, X, Q, W, A, S, D, Shift and the Arrow Keys.

name: Combat Controls
info:
Arrow Keys: Move the menu cursor. 
Z: Select a character's action. 
X Move to the combat overview menu. 
Shift: Examine the highlighted target. 
Q & W: Switch info screens for the examined target.

name: Main Stats
info:
The gear you equip and the abilities you take will factor 
heavily into your character's stats. 
Specifically, the six Main Stats: 
Attack: Damage you deal with physical attacks.
Defense: Damage you take from physical attacks.
Magic Attack: Damage you deal with magical attacks.
Magic Defense: Damage you take from magical attacks.
Agility: Order characters will act in battle.
Luck: Chance you will evade attacks, and to critically hit.

name: Extra Stats
info:
There are variety of secondary stats the can also have an 
important effect in battle. 
Some are calculated using other stats. 
Hit Rate: Calculated from your ATK and AGI. 
Evasion Rate: Calculated from your AGI and LUK. 
Critical Rate: Calculated from your LUK. 
Guard Rate: Calculated from your DEF and MDF.

name: Cheat Codes
info:
Using the 'Cheats' option on the main menu, you can 
access the cheat code input screen. Here you'll be able to 
input codes with a wide variety of effects, from unique 
starting equipment to skipping entire parts of the game.
Example Codes:
SKIP1 : Skip the intro, starting in Caste City 
SKIP3 : Skip to the end of the Coastal Zone 
Rosebud : Add 1000G to the next loaded save file 
And many more!

name: Fate Locked
info:
During gameplay there may be times when you have 
wandered into an inescapeable situation. 
When these situations occur, your fate will be 'locked' and 
an overlay will appear around the edges of the screen. 
This is a warning to be careful about saving the game, even 
though you can, doesn't mean you should. Unless you really 
want to come back to that helpless state. Definitely not. 
Note: Not all inescapable situations have been updated to 
show the overlay. You have a lot of save slots, use them!
